title: Measles Outbreak and Federal Leadership Conflict Intensify
subtitle: As cases rise in Pennsylvania, national leaders face growing calls for accountability over vaccine information.

summary.en: A serious measles outbreak in Pennsylvania has led to two deaths and hundreds of infections. U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has faced intense criticism for questioning the official cause of these deaths. Meanwhile, lawmakers are now calling for a criminal investigation into Kennedy's past statements. The conflict highlights a deep divide over public health policy and the role of government officials. Experts warn that misinformation is making it harder to control the spread of the virus.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州嚴重的麻疹疫情已導致兩人死亡及數百人感染。美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪因質疑這些死亡案例的官方死因，面臨強烈批評。與此同時，國會議員正呼籲對甘迺迪過去的言論進行刑事調查。這場衝突凸顯了在公共衛生政策與政府官員職責上的巨大分歧。專家警告，錯誤資訊正使得控制病毒傳播變得更加困難。

paragraphs.en: A serious measles outbreak in Pennsylvania has become the center of a national debate over public health and the role of government leaders. According to The Guardian, about 424 people in the state have confirmed cases of measles, with 73 patients requiring hospital care. The situation has become even more difficult as officials struggle to manage the spread of the virus while facing conflicting messages from the highest levels of the U.S. government.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州爆發嚴重的麻疹疫情，成為全國關於公共衛生與政府領導人職責辯論的焦點。根據《衛報 (The Guardian)》報導，該州約有四百二十四人確診麻疹，其中七十三名患者需要住院治療。由於官員們在努力控制病毒傳播的同時，還面臨來自美國政府高層相互矛盾的訊息，使得情況變得更加棘手。

paragraphs.en: At the heart of the controversy is U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. After two unvaccinated people died in Lancaster County, Kennedy suggested that these deaths might have been “fabricated,” or made up. This claim was supported by a local Republican coroner who suggested one death was not related to the virus. However, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro has strongly criticized Kennedy’s comments. During a press conference, Shapiro warned that there are “real-life consequences to spreading misinformation,” noting that the state is dealing with a dangerous health crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 爭議的核心在於美國衛生部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪 (Robert F. Kennedy Jr.)。在蘭開斯特郡有兩名未接種疫苗的民眾死亡後，甘迺迪暗示這些死亡案例可能是「捏造」或虛構的。此說法得到了一位當地共和黨籍驗屍官的支持，該驗屍官稱其中一起死亡案例與病毒無關。然而，賓夕法尼亞州州長喬什·夏皮羅 (Josh Shapiro) 強烈批評了甘迺迪的言論。夏皮羅在記者會上警告稱，「散布錯誤資訊會帶來現實生活中的後果」，並指出該州正處於危險的健康危機之中。

paragraphs.en: Medical experts have expressed deep concern about the federal government’s response. Paul Offit, an infectious diseases physician at the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia, described the situation as “the world turned upside down.” He noted that because officials have not released more details about the patients, it has created “fertile ground” for conspiracy theories. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) stated on the social media platform X that it is working to find out exactly what happened and whether the two deaths were caused by the measles virus.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學專家對聯邦政府的反應表示深切擔憂。費城兒童醫院的傳染病醫師保羅·奧菲特 (Paul Offit) 形容這種情況是「世界顛倒了」。他指出，由於官員們沒有公布更多關於患者的細節，這為陰謀論創造了「肥沃的土壤」。美國疾病管制與預防中心 (CDC) 在社群媒體平台 X 上表示，正致力於查明真相，並釐清這兩起死亡案例是否確實由麻疹病毒引起。

paragraphs.en: While public health officials try to manage the outbreak, anti-vaccine activists are becoming more active. Brian Hooker, a representative from the organization Children’s Health Defense, said in a video that his group is trying to reach the families of the deceased. This has caused alarm among health experts, who remember how activists previously used the death of a young girl in Texas to spread misinformation. Vaccines are known to be 97% effective at preventing measles, yet none of the people sickened in the current Pennsylvania outbreak were fully vaccinated.
paragraphs.zh: 在公共衛生官員試圖控制疫情之際，反疫苗活動人士也變得更加活躍。代表「兒童健康防衛 (Children’s Health Defense)」組織的布萊恩·胡克 (Brian Hooker) 在一段影片中表示，他的團隊正試圖接觸死者家屬。這引起了衛生專家的警覺，他們回想起活動人士過去曾如何利用德州一名小女孩的死亡來散布錯誤資訊。眾所周知，疫苗在預防麻疹方面的有效率高達百分之九十七，然而此次賓州疫情中的患者無一人完全接種過疫苗。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the immediate health crisis, the political pressure on Kennedy is growing. According to Ars Technica, several U.S. senators are now calling for Kennedy to step down from his position. Some lawmakers are even requesting a criminal investigation, claiming that new documents prove Kennedy lied to the Senate during his confirmation hearings last year. Senator Edward J. Markey stated that Kennedy has “jeopardized the health of children to advance his anti-vaccine agenda.” Senator Ron Wyden also called for a formal investigation, arguing that there must be consequences for providing false information to Congress.
paragraphs.zh: 除了眼前的健康危機外，甘迺迪面臨的政治壓力也日益增加。根據《Ars Technica》報導，幾位美國參議員目前正要求甘迺迪辭職。一些國會議員甚至要求進行刑事調查，聲稱有新文件證明甘迺迪去年在參議院的任命聽證會上撒謊。參議員愛德華·馬基 (Edward J. Markey) 表示，甘迺迪為了推動其反疫苗議程，「危及了兒童的健康」。參議員羅恩·懷登 (Ron Wyden) 也呼籲進行正式調查，主張向國會提供虛假資訊必須承擔後果。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time Kennedy’s history has been questioned. During his confirmation hearings, senators raised concerns about his 2019 trip to Samoa. Shortly after his visit, the island nation experienced a massive measles outbreak that killed 83 people, most of whom were children under the age of five. Reports indicate that the outbreak was made worse by a sharp drop in vaccination rates, which fell to as low as 31 percent following campaigns by anti-vaccine activists.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非甘迺迪的過往紀錄首次受到質疑。在任命聽證會期間，參議員們曾對他二〇一九年前往薩摩亞的行程提出疑慮。在他訪問後不久，該島國爆發了大規模麻疹疫情，造成八十三人死亡，其中大多數是五歲以下的兒童。報告指出，由於反疫苗活動人士的宣傳，疫苗接種率驟降至百分之三十一，導致疫情惡化。

paragraphs.en: As the situation in Pennsylvania continues, the divide between state officials and federal leadership remains wide. While Governor Shapiro focuses on the immediate health needs of his citizens, the national conversation has shifted toward the credibility of the Department of Health and Human Services. The outcome of these calls for an investigation could have a lasting impact on how the U.S. government handles public health emergencies in the future. For now, health experts continue to urge the public to rely on verified medical information to protect their communities from the spread of the virus.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著賓州的局勢持續發展，州政府官員與聯邦領導層之間的分歧依然巨大。當夏皮羅州長專注於滿足公民迫切的健康需求時，全國性的討論已轉向衛生與公共服務部的公信力。這些調查呼聲的結果，可能會對美國政府未來處理公共衛生緊急事件的方式產生深遠影響。目前，衛生專家持續呼籲大眾依賴經過驗證的醫療資訊，以保護社區免受病毒傳播的威脅。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation or environment that makes it easy for something (often negative) to develop or grow.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 滋生某事（通常指負面事物）的溫床或有利環境。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是「肥沃的土地」，這裡比喻容易滋生陰謀論的環境。文中：He noted that because officials have not released more details about the patients, it has created “fertile ground” for conspiracy theories.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To resign or leave an important job or position.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見的片語，但容易與「走下台階」的字面意思混淆。文中：According to Ars Technica, several U.S. senators are now calling for Kennedy to step down from his position.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To put something in a situation where it could be lost, damaged, or destroyed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是較正式的動詞，容易被誤認為名詞或形容詞。文中：Senator Edward J. Markey stated that Kennedy has “jeopardized the health of children to advance his anti-vaccine agenda.”

quiz.question: What specific detail is mentioned regarding the vaccination status of the individuals affected by the current measles outbreak in Pennsylvania?

options.A: Approximately 31 percent of the patients had received at least one dose of the vaccine.
options.B: None of the individuals who became ill during this outbreak had received full vaccination.
options.C: Most of the patients were children under the age of five who had not been vaccinated.
options.D: The majority of the 424 patients had been vaccinated, but the vaccine proved ineffective.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段結尾明確指出：「none of the people sickened in the current Pennsylvania outbreak were fully vaccinated」。選項 A 是關於薩摩亞疫情的數據，並非賓州；選項 C 雖然提到薩摩亞疫情多為五歲以下兒童，但並未說明賓州患者的年齡比例；選項 D 與文意完全相反，疫苗在文中被提及有 97% 的效力。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why are medical experts particularly worried about the involvement of anti-vaccine groups in the current Pennsylvania situation?

options.A: These groups are demanding that the government release more medical records of the deceased.
options.B: These groups are providing financial support to the families of those who died from measles.
options.C: Experts fear a repeat of past behavior where activists exploited tragedy to spread misinformation.
options.D: Experts believe these groups are responsible for the initial spread of the virus in Lancaster County.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第四段提到，專家對於反疫苗組織接觸死者家屬感到擔憂，原因在於他們曾利用德州一名女孩的死亡來散布錯誤訊息。這暗示了專家擔心歷史重演。選項 A 並非專家擔憂的主因；選項 B 文中未提及；選項 D 文中並未指控這些團體是病毒的原始傳播者，僅提到他們在疫情期間變得更活躍。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the phrase 'fertile ground' imply in the context of the government's lack of transparency?

options.A: A situation that is highly favorable for the growth and development of something.
options.B: A piece of agricultural land that is prepared for planting new crops.
options.C: A physical location where medical research is being conducted.
options.D: A stable environment that prevents the spread of rumors.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「fertile ground」為隱喻用法，指缺乏資訊的環境就像肥沃的土壤，非常適合陰謀論（conspiracy theories）滋生與發展。選項 B 是字面意義，不符合文章語境；選項 C 與醫學研究無關；選項 D 與原文意思相反，缺乏資訊反而會助長而非遏止謠言。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the central theme of the article?

options.A: The medical history of Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and his past trips to island nations.
options.B: The effectiveness of measles vaccines compared to other public health interventions.
options.C: A measles outbreak in Pennsylvania has triggered a national conflict over government credibility and public health leadership.
options.D: The legal procedures required for the U.S. Senate to remove a cabinet member from office.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文開頭即點出賓州麻疹疫情引發了關於公共衛生與政府領導角色的全國性辯論，隨後各段落皆圍繞此核心衝突展開，包含 Kennedy 的爭議言論、專家對政府回應的質疑，以及國會對其職位的調查。選項 A、B、D 皆僅為文章中的部分細節，無法涵蓋全文探討的公共衛生危機與政治信任危機之主旨。
